A user still choosing between MuleSoft and point-to-point has not reached three-tier design yet. Recommend relabelling to integration/middleware-integration-patterns. SEPARATE REAL CORPUS DEFECT surfaced by this case, worth its own work item: architect/api-led-connectivity-architecture and integration/api-led-connectivity are near-clones of one topic split across two domains — both lead on System/Process/Experience layers, both tag mulesoft + agent-fabric, and neither names the other in a NOT-for, so a query about API layering can land in either domain by coin-flip. Fix with LEVER 1: pick one canonical home, and add to the survivor's description `NOT for <the other's residual scope> — use <other-slug>`, or fold the pair into a single package.
